title: European officials warn of sharp rise in Russian sabotage but assess no imminent direct NATO military attack
detail: European security officials warned of a sharp rise in Russian sabotage operations across the continent, while simultaneously assessing that there is no imminent threat of a direct NATO military attack. The assessment reflects growing concern about hybrid warfare tactics targeting critical infrastructure and institutions below the threshold of conventional conflict.

media.caption: European security officials assess Russian sabotage surge poses no imminent NATO military threat
